mode: protected production background/UI and real Chromium IndexedDB; Chrome extension APIs and media preparation are explicit doubles; no actual browser preference or filesystem destination changed

outcomes.name: A fresh installation blocks first direct download before preparation, history and media requests
Detected media, retry and the keyboard shortcut share the same first-folder guard
Website and cross-mode senders cannot acknowledge or open folder settings
The folder change action opens only Chrome downloads settings without confirming setup
Explicit confirmation commits to IndexedDB and survives page/service-worker recreation
Confirmed original, stream and audio downloads request automatic save with collision-safe basenames
Failed confirmation commit and failed settings reads cannot silently enable downloads
Private first-use acknowledgement remains in memory and never reads or writes the normal database
First-use settings explain the actual Chrome folder and prevent false download-start UI
Folder settings UI exposes failed read/commit and recovers only after an authoritative reread
